title: Organizations
subtitle: The top-level ownership boundary — mailboxes and rule graphs each belong to exactly one.
emptyDescription: Create one to start adding mailboxes under it.
slugInvalid: Slug must be lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens (e.g. "acme-security").
mailboxesEmptyTitle: No mailboxes under this organization yet.
mailboxesEmptyDescription: Use the Add mailbox or Bulk import tab to create some.
switchToManage: Switch to this organization to manage →
needWrite: You need organizations:write on this organization to change this.
inviteEmailSent: Invite email sent to {email}. The link below also works if they don't receive it.
inviteNoEmail: No outbound email is configured — copy this link and share it with {email} yourself:
membersNoPermissionTitle: You don't have permission to view members of this organization.
membersNoPermissionDescription: Ask an owner for members:read access.
revokeMemberDescription: They immediately lose access to this organization. This does not delete their account or their access to other organizations.
reviewPolicyIntro: Jev scores every email for whether a human should look at it. When that score reaches the threshold below, the email goes straight to Human Review and your rules are skipped. Raise it if too much ordinary mail is landing in review; turn it off to let rules alone decide.
forceReview: Force Human Review when Jev flags an email
digestIntro: Send a summary of newly arrived review items to members of this organization who can see reviews. One email per interval, never one per email. Requires outbound SMTP to be configured in Settings.
reviewSaved: Saved. Applies to newly arriving email.
forwardingIntro: Limits for destinations that forward email to other addresses. Every recipient also has to confirm by email before anything is sent to it.
forwardDailyLimitHelp: Protects against a rule that matches far more mail than intended. Once reached, further forwards go to Human Review. 0 turns forwarding off.
allowedDomainsHelp: One domain per line. Leave empty to allow any domain. When set, email can only be forwarded to addresses at these domains.
emailLanguageHelp: The language of emails sent to people who don't have a Eumaeus account, such as forward recipients and the notes on forwarded mail. Members get emails in their own language.
alertsIntro: Eumaeus watches for problems every 5 minutes: a mailbox that keeps failing to sync, an expired sign-in, a burst of failed actions or Jev errors, forwards that can't be sent. Open problems appear on the Overview. You're told once when a problem starts, again each day it lasts, and once when it clears.
alertEmails: Email members who can manage this organization
webhookReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new URL to replace it
webhookHelp: Receives a JSON POST for each alert opened or resolved. Private network addresses are refused.
retentionIntro: Leave a field empty to keep forever. Removal runs hourly and deletes Eumaeus's own copy only; the message in the mailbox stays.
bodyRetentionHelp: Text, HTML and the original copy go; subject, sender, Jev's analysis and the decision stay. Such emails can no longer be forwarded.
emailRetentionHelp: The email and everything derived from it. Audit entries stay, reduced to ids.
erasureIntro: Deletes every email this organization holds from the address (as sender or Reply-To), with its analysis, decisions and actions, plus auto-reply history and suggestions naming it. The audit log records only that it happened. This can't be undone.
needErase: You need privacy:erase on this organization to do this.
senderListNote: The address is also on the allow/block list. That entry is your configuration and is kept; remove it on Sender lists if the request covers it.
retypeToConfirm: Type the address again to confirm
apiKeysNeedManage: You need api_keys:manage on this organization to see its API keys.
apiKeysIntro: Use a key from scripts and other systems: Authorization: Bearer jm_…. It works only in this organization, only with the permissions chosen here, and can't manage members or other keys.
revokeKeyDescription: Anything using this key stops working immediately. This can't be undone.
copyKeyNow: Copy the key for "{name}" now. It won't be shown again.
keyNamePlaceholder: What uses it, e.g. CRM sync
keyPermissionsHelp: Only permissions you have here are offered. Give a key the least it needs.
verifyMissingToken: This confirmation link is missing its token. Open the link from the email again.
verifyConfirmedBody: {address} will now receive the emails that {organization} forwards to it. The organization can stop this at any time.
verifyIntro: An organization using Eumaeus wants to forward some of its incoming emails to your address. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
verifyNotExpecting: If you weren't expecting this, close this page. Nothing will be forwarded to you.
questionsNeedRead: You need rules:read on this organization to see its Jev questions.
questionsNeedWrite: You need rules:write on this organization to add, edit or delete questions.
questionsIntro: Jev answers these questions about every new email, together with the 8 built-in ones. A rule can use the answer as answers..
questionsCostNote: Each question adds a small cost to every email Jev analyzes.
questionsPastEmailsNote: Emails that already arrived don't have the answer. To get it for one, open the email and use Reprocess with "Ask Jev again".
questionsEmpty: No questions of your own yet.
questionsLimitReached: This organization has reached the limit of {limit} questions. Delete one to add another.
questionTypeNoulHelp: Jev answers with a probability from 0 to 1 that the answer is yes.
questionTypeChoiceHelp: Jev picks exactly one of the options you list; rules compare against the option key.
questionTypeScoreHelp: Jev picks one level from your ordered list, lowest first.
questionEditHint: Only the wording and the criteria can change; the key and type stay the same.
questionUsedByNone: Not used by any rule yet.
questionInUse: This question is still used by:
questionDeleteAnywayHelp: If you delete it anyway, conditions that read this answer will stop matching.
questionDeleteDescription: Jev stops asking it about new emails. Answers already stored on past emails stay, but the key can't be reused.
questionTextPlaceholder: e.g. Is the sender asking for an invoice or a receipt?
questionOptionsHint: 2–{max} options. The option key (lowercase letters, digits, underscores) is the value rules compare against; the description tells Jev when to pick it.
questionOptionDescriptionPlaceholder: When Jev should pick this option
questionKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. It can't be changed later.
questionTipYesHigh: Phrase yes/no questions so that a high value means yes ("Is this urgent?", not "Can this wait?").
hoursIntro: The rule condition email.business_hours is true when an email arrives inside these hours. Without working hours set, the condition never matches.
hoursNotSet: No working hours are set, so the working-hours condition never matches.
hoursOvernightHint: An end time earlier than the start time means an overnight window (e.g. 22:00–06:00).
hoursOvernightActive: Overnight window: from {start} until {end} the next day.
addWithSignIn: Sign in with Google or Microsoft
addWithSignInHelp: The easiest way for Gmail and Microsoft 365: no app password; you sign in to the account and the mailbox is added to this organization.
addWithPassword: Or add it with IMAP and a password
assignNotifyIntro: When review items are assigned to someone, they get an email listing them. To avoid one email per item, choose how many assigned items to gather before emailing. Taking an item yourself sends nothing.
assignNotifyEnabled: Email members about items assigned to them
assignNotifyBatch: One email once {count} items assigned to the same person are waiting (resolved or reassigned items don't count).
assignNotifyInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
deactivateIntro: Deactivating stops mail coming in for all of this organization's mailboxes. Nothing is deleted, and it can be reactivated at any time. A deactivated organization can then be deleted permanently by the system administrator.
deactivateDescription: Its mailboxes stop syncing; rules, emails and history stay. You can reactivate it any time.
deactivatedNotice: This organization is deactivated: its mailboxes don't sync.
deletePermanentlyHint: Deletes the organization with all its mailboxes, emails, rules, destinations, members' access and audit trail. The deletion itself is recorded under your account.
deleteDescription: Everything this organization holds in Eumaeus is deleted: mailboxes, emails, analyses, decisions, rules, rule graphs, destinations, sender lists, members' access, API keys and its audit trail. This can't be undone. Nothing in the mailboxes themselves is touched; user accounts stay.
